title: 2 public functions lack docstrings (use_unified_limits L33, registered_limits L47)
detail: use_unified_limits (called from local.py and placement.py) and registered_limits (a method of IdentityClient) have no docstrings. Add a one-line docstring to each; for use_unified_limits, document its dependency on CONF.quota.driver.

title: Class IdentityClient lacks a docstring
detail: IdentityClient has no class docstring. Add a brief description explaining its role as a Keystone identity proxy and noting the connection, service_id, and region_id parameters.

title: Global statement in _identity_client creates a mutable singleton without thread safety
detail: Line 53 uses 'global IDENTITY_CLIENT' for lazy singleton initialisation. In a concurrent environment two threads can both observe IDENTITY_CLIENT as None and each create a client; the second overwrites the first. Use a module-level lock or threading.local to guard the singleton creation.

title: _identity_client has maximum nesting depth 6, exceeding threshold of 4
detail: lizard reports nesting=6 (threshold 4) in _identity_client (lines 52-88). Extract the innermost conditional and error-handling blocks into helper functions to reduce nesting.

title: should_enforce has maximum nesting depth 7, exceeding threshold of 4
detail: lizard reports nesting=7 (threshold 4) in should_enforce (lines 91-182), a 92-line business logic function with CCN=12. Flatten by extracting the per-limit-type classification loops into named helpers.
